summary: Circular particle-buffer slot allocation. Advances a circular write index (this[24], offset 0x60) with wraparound at capacity (this[22], offset 0x58), computes the slot address from the buffer base (this[23], offset 0x5C) using a 108-byte slot stride, and returns it. When the slot's state/link word is negative (slot free), links the slot into the active-slot list, appends its address to the tracking array (this[26], offset 0x68) while incrementing the allocation count (this[25], offset 0x64), and resets the slot via sub_558A30. The index always advances; the caller is responsible for capacity.

local_names.v1: current circular write index (this[24]) before advance
local_names.v4: slot state/link word at v5 + 4; negative means free
local_names.v5: address of the selected slot (buffer base + 108 * index)

operations.description: Read the circular write index v1 = this[24] and the buffer capacity v2 = this[22]; advance the index (this[24] = v1 + 1) and wrap it to 0 when it reaches capacity
v3 = this[23] loads the slot buffer base; v5 = v3 + 108 * v1 addresses the chosen slot (108-byte slot stride)
Read the slot's state/link word v4 = *(v5 + 4); the free-slot bookkeeping runs only while v4 < 0 (slot unclaimed)
*(v5 + 4) = this[25] links the now-claimed slot to the allocation-count value
*(this[26] + 4 * this[25]++) = v5 stores the slot address in the tracking array at this[26] and increments the allocation count this[25]
sub_558A30(v1) initializes / ages the claimed slot at index v1 (age reset for a recycled slot)
Return v5, the claimed slot pointer; the circular index advances unconditionally and the caller must honor capacity
Invoked by the particle emitters ParticleCollisionSpark, ParticleTrailEmitter, ParticleSpawnFunction, WheelContactParticle and sub_4CC970

unresolved: Whether this[25] is a plain counter or a link token is inferred from its use both as the value written into the slot link word and as the tracking-array index
sub_558A30's exact slot-initialization work is unverified; treated as slot age reset from call context
